title: Implant Slot 06
doc: Slice toggle. Off: Slices.VerdictForOverlay skips every file below before
it is opened, so none of its rows reach RulePlan. These files are loaded
by the row-edit engine, so they also have no effect while [Slices]
ModelRules is off (ModelRules.Init returns before Overlays.Load).
Files this toggle gates:
implants-slot06.csv
One of the 11 character implant slot sheets. Each carries only the
ImplantModel columns live for its own slot, plus the EffectModel
columns its own effects use. ImplantSlot 100-107, the 20 drone modules,
get no sheet and no toggle.
Lever sheet, not a direct overlay: the first column is ImplantName, and
there is no game table called "implants-slot06". Implants.Expand
turns each row into ImplantModel and EffectModel writes at load.
Slot help, copied by hand from Implants.SlotHelp (Implants.cs); nothing
checks that the two agree:
These 25 rows include the 16 cyberweapon claws (ImplantClass 27). The
claws are ALSO in cyberweapons-claws.csv, and the columns do not
collide: this table carries the install economics and the implant-side
effect, that sheet carries the weapon and talent combat stats. Cost
here is the CLINIC PRICE (80-10200 across the table); Cost there is the
item's valuation (50-700). Every class-27 row has ImplantEffectId 0, so
its payload cells are blank and there is nothing here to edit for a
claw's effect.
uiDoc: Turn this off and the mod skips this page's files, so nothing on this page is applied.

fields.label: Enable Implant Slot 06
